text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: They were quite the tough opponent, weren't they?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... aren't those eyes lovely?
Burning with pure obsession—simply gorgeous.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, let it nourish you.
Turn today's defeat into fuel for the victory you will one day grasp."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It ended in a disappointing result...
